subject: 40 Century Street Condemnation Hearing
overview: The Board of Health stayed condemnation proceedings for 40 Century Street for 30 days to allow safety repairs to proceed, received updates on outreach programs and disease surveillance, and honored retiring member Kathleen Charbonnier.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The Board approved the meeting minutes from May 2026.

items.title: 40 Century Street Non-Emergency Condemnation Hearing
items.summary: The Board voted to stay condemnation of 40 Century Street for 30 days pending re-inspection, with priority placed on addressing fall risks and other immediate safety hazards.

items.title: Medford Connects and Outreach Team Update
items.summary: Catherine Dhingra and Patrick Donovan presented the Medford Connects team's work over the past six months, focusing on multilingual community outreach, immigrant support, ESOL programming, and health resource navigation.

items.title: Reportable Disease Report
items.summary: Public health nurse Jill presented year-to-date reportable disease surveillance data and noted upcoming vaccination efforts.

items.title: Board Member Recognition and Other Business
items.summary: The Board recognized long-serving member Kathleen Charbonnier upon her upcoming retirement and discussed coordination with the Mass General Brigham mobile health van.
